**Answer to the King's question**

(1) My source contains no earlier hulpslag, Kroonklok, or datanet change record for days 9 or 10. The datanet's connection is recorded only as HIS-006 (23 years ago). Day 9 entries are HIS-032, HIS-033, and HIS-034, none about the datanet. No authorizer is named for day 9 or day 10. ENG-011, ENG-106, and ENG-105 are not in my source, so I cannot confirm the 02:40 activation. The day 10 entries are HIS-035 ("de Burchtader stokte even", 04:45, logged 07:20) and HIS-036 (complaint of half-arrived messages, 04:50, logged dag 9 23:55).

(2) HIS-014 records a "inspectie woudkabels door de datatoren, niets gewijzigd" on dag 3 at 08:30. My source does not contain BEA-102, so I cannot confirm its wording. HIS-007 and HIS-105 state the woudkabels were laid 23 years ago and have not been changed, moved, or replaced. I have no record of any cable change or of any work on the oude eik before day 10.

(3) No. My source has no per-date baseline for throughput, shield seals, or animal onrust. The only animal entries are births (HIS-017, HIS-030, HIS-057), and HIS-002 records only the shields' construction. I cannot test the four-day rhythm, and ENG-026, GUA-043, GUA-019, and BEA-046 are not in my source. I also withdraw my earlier claim in HIS-114 that this is a return of the Stille Winter: HIS-107 describes that winter as having no rhythm, and I have no record that supports the comparison.

**How it works**
The Kroonklok has one pols carrying the leylijnen, the schilden, the archief, and the datanet (HIS-102, HIS-006). Records written on another pols can be read only there (HIS-110). HIS-103 says vastgelegd_op always equals gebeurd_op.

**Sequence & anomalies**
- HIS-035: dag 10 04:45 gebeurd, dag 10 07:20 vastgelegd.
- HIS-036: dag 10 04:50 gebeurd, dag 9 23:55 vastgelegd (logged before it happened).
- HIS-053: dag 22 04:15 gebeurd, dag 22 01:50 vastgelegd.
- HIS-112 and HIS-116 attribute the timestamp errors on days 10 and 22 to clerks.
- HIS-103 is contradicted by these entries.

**Recovery & constraints**
Per HIS-110, make a copy of the register before rejoining the pols slowly. If a pols drops out, records on it are lost.

**Unasked findings**
- HIS-106: no leylijn hapering in 23 years of datanet operation.
- HIS-036 conflicts with HIS-103 and must be checked against the original logs.
- HIS-109 and HIS-110 contain the build charter for the pols.
